about: The pull requests that took Relay from canonical 4.21.0 to 4.22.0 (Chapter 9). Each changed file is assigned to exactly one pull request, the one that changed it, and is counted there whole. PR-0's governance changes merge first, so that every later pull request is held to the rule it is checked against. Code owners are computed from CODEOWNERS as it was at each pull request's base. Sizes are measured by prkit from data/relay-4.21.0 and solution/relay-repo, not written here. Review minutes and dates are part of the book's fictional Relay.
